content.description:
# EOC - Executive Operations Center
# EOC 3.5 TEST - Build 286
Expanded-frame correction for the native Solution Planner.
- Removes Build 285's disproven table reservation. - Expands the bounded EOC frame from 78% to 80% of the viewport, providing approximately 1552 pixels beneath the header against X4's proven 1518-pixel planner requirement. - Preserves native blueprint, recipe, dependency, hourly-rate, and module-count evidence without truncation. - Preserves explicit/on-demand Supply, native scrolling, same-page position, Raw Scrap exclusion, and every prior authority boundary.
Build 286 is TEST-only and requires live proof before promotion.
Compatible with X4 8.x and 9.x.
